body:
## Tier header

- **Tier:** T4
- **Why:** personal data and destructive deletion. This is the client's only way to find and permanently erase their Roman (AI) chats (owner 10-01 20:32 "keep AI chats forever", ruling OR-110-1 "a client-initiated chat delete erases them"). It also binds the screens to the signed-in account (account isolation on a shared device).
- **T4 trigger scan:** PII (chat history and transcript), destructive data (DELETE one / DELETE all), auth/account boundary (account switch fence). No CI gate files, no workflows, no package.json/lockfile, no env names, no migrations.
- **T3 trigger scan:** consumes a new backend contract (#635 `GET /roman/sessions`, `DELETE /roman/sessions[/:id]`). Navigator route additions in both role navigators.
- **Bounded T1:** none claimed.
- **Builder / owner:** lane S-ROMAN-CHATS (agent 112), Claude Opus 5.5 builder. Owner Bradley; merge and deploy by the operator only.
- **Acceptance evidence:** targeted jest (below) and CI Typecheck/lint/test at the exact head.
- **Promotion triggers:** already T4.

## Release note

**Needs backend #635 deployed** (operator handles ship order). Against a backend without #635 the list shows "Your conversation history is not available on our side yet ..." (uncoded 404 mapped), nothing is deleted and nothing crashes. "Or your account" in the copy needs backend #608.

## What it does

A "Your conversations with Roman" screen:

- **Entry points:** Settings > Privacy > Roman and AI (new row), the Roman chat header (new icon button), and coach Settings > Privacy (same build gate as the client Roman and AI row). The routes `RomanConversations` / `RomanConversation` are registered in the client More stack and the coach Settings stack **without** the Roman chat flag, matching the backend (list and delete are outside the chat switch).
- **List:** every chat (any day, both surfaces), newest first, 30 per page with the backend keyset cursor ("Show older conversations" + end-reached), local date and message count, coach-tool chats labelled.
- **Open one:** read-only transcript (`GET /roman/sessions/:id/messages`, oldest first, "Show earlier messages"). When the server's Roman chat switch is off (uncoded 404) it says reading is switched off and still offers Delete.
- **Delete one:** confirm sheet with plain permanent-delete copy; optimistic removal, rollback to the same place on failure, retry. 404 `ROMAN_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` is the requested outcome ("already deleted"); a repeat delete is a quiet 204 server-side (C-635-2).
- **Delete all:** confirm sheet plus typing `DELETE`; optimistic empty list; rollback on failure; after a partial (503 `ROMAN_ERASE_INCOMPLETE`) or unknown failure the list is re-read to show exactly what is left. Waits for any single delete still in flight.
- **Account binding:** every request remembers its account; sign-out clears list and transcript at once; sign-in re-reads for the new account; late answers for the previous account are dropped; no delete is sent unless the account that loaded the list is still signed in. Nothing stored on the device; `ph-no-capture` on both screens.
- **States:** loading (labelled progress), empty, offline (copy + Try again, auto re-read when the connection returns), error.
- **Errors (status + machine code, never message text):** offline, 401, 403, 404 `ROMAN_SESSION_NOT_FOUND`, uncoded 404, 400 `ROMAN_CURSOR_INVALID` (auto re-read from the top), 400 `ROMAN_SESSIONS_QUERY_INVALID` (#635 fix round B-635-5: outdated app, update copy + reference + Sentry), 503 `ROMAN_ERASE_INCOMPLETE` (one / all copy; the one-chat copy never says "not changed" because #635's fix round B-635-4 also returns this code when an erase cannot be confirmed), 429, unknown -> short reference + Contact support (mailto with the reference only) + Sentry with status, code, request id only (no content, no ids). Delete copy never claims a result the server did not confirm.

### Also fixed (found while building): Roman ids are cuid, not uuid

`src/api/romanApi.ts` validated session, message and stream `messageId` as `z.string().uuid()`, but the backend ids are `@default(cuid())` (`prisma/schema.prisma` RomanSession / RomanMessage). Every open, transcript read and send would fail the strict wire check against the real backend. Changed to `z.string().min(1).max(64)` (the DTO cursor bound) on those three lines only; pinned by `romanChatsApi.test.ts` "romanApi ids are cuid". These lines are outside mobile #326's hunks (merge-tree auto-merges `romanApi.ts`).

### #635 fix round (B-CONSENT-4) codes

Mapped from the B-CONSENT-4 working tree before it was pushed (`ROMAN_SESSIONS_QUERY_INVALID`; unconfirmed erase reuses `ROMAN_ERASE_INCOMPLETE` with a "could not confirm" message). If the pushed #635 head names different codes, this PR needs a small follow-up in `failureOf` and `failureView`. Any code not listed falls to reference + Contact support + Sentry, never a generic message.

## Parallel lane

Additive next to mobile #326 (B-CONSENT-4): new files under `src/screens/settings/`, `src/api/romanChatsApi.ts`, one import + one JSX line in `RomanChatScreen.tsx` header, one row in `RomanAiConsentScreen.tsx`, three id validators in `romanApi.ts`. No #326 file other than those two lines' neighbours.

## Tests (targeted, `--runInBand`, via ops/heavy.sh)

New: `src/api/__tests__/romanChatsApi.test.ts`, `src/screens/settings/__tests__/RomanConversationsScreen.test.tsx`, `src/screens/settings/__tests__/RomanConversationScreen.test.tsx`, `src/components/roman/__tests__/RomanConversationsButton.test.tsx`, `src/navigation/__tests__/romanConversationsReachable.test.ts`. Re-run neighbours: `romanApi.test.ts`, `romanA11yR3.test.tsx`, `RomanAiConsentScreen.test.tsx`, `romanFlagOff.test.ts`. Result: 8 suites / 125 tests pass (first run); the fix-round mapping re-run is noted in the report. All new tests fail on main (files absent; the cuid test fails against main's uuid schemas).
